evs.text: Welcome back, ninja! I'm so happy to see you.
Next is a new game, called Sorting. Tap the glowing stone to play.
You know this sound! Now let's look at the different ways we spell it.
This game is called Sorting. Every word goes in the chest with the same spelling.
This sound can be spelt in three ways. Tap each chest to open it.
This is the way we spell it in cat.
In kit, it's spelt like this.
In duck, it's spelt like this.
It's two letters, but it's one sound.
I'll sort the first one. My word is...
I can see this spelling at the end.
So it goes in this chest.
Now you do one. Are you ready?
Tap the chest with the same spelling as the word.
Same sound, different spellings. You sorted them all.
More stickers for your Sticker Book!
Look, a gem! Each gem holds a way to spell a sound. When you get words right, it fills up.
Wow, you got everything right! Grown-ups, if this is too easy, you can jump ahead.
The glowing stone is your next game. Tap it when you're ready.
Sorting time! Same sound, different spellings.
This sound can be spelt in two ways.
This is the way we spell it in chick.
This one's two letters too, but it's just one sound.
In match, it's spelt like this.
Tap the chest with the same spelling as the word.
Ten in a row! Look how your ninja is glowing!
Same sound, different spellings. You sorted them all.
More stickers for your Sticker Book!
Look, this gem has filled a little more.
The glowing stone is your next game. Tap it when you're ready.
Back to the dojo. Today there are two new sounds.
You can hear it in rain, tail and nail.
Tap the petal, and say it with me.
Now watch my ninja write it.
It's two letters, but it's one sound.
Now you tap it, and say the sound.
Tap it once more, and say it again.
Good, you said that sound really well.
Our next sound is one you know...
Tap its petal, and say it.
Now watch my ninja write it.
This is another way to spell the sound...
This one's two letters too, but it's just one sound.
Now you tap it, and say it.
Two new sounds! You said every one.
Now let's play Ninja Eyes, with your new sounds.
Tap the petal if you want to hear the sound again.
Which of these is the way we write...
Which of these is the way we write...
Now let's build some words with your new sounds.
Let's say the sounds, the slow way...
Now tap the rabbit, and read the word fast.
There's a slow way to say a word, and a fast way.
Say the sounds, and read the word.
You said it slowly, and found every sound.
Let's say it the slow way...
Say the sounds, and read the word.
First the slow way, like the tortoise...
Now the fast way, like the rabbit...
You built words with their sounds, and you read them.
Let's see what you won back from Baron Muddle.
Look, these gems have filled a little more.
Now let's go and see where your sounds live. Tap the green arrow.
You found a new sound! Look, here is its petal, shining through the mist.
This is the way we spell it in rain.
We see this spelling in tail and nail.
You found a new gem! It's a spelling of the sound...
Now you know two ways to spell...
Your World Flower is waiting for more sounds. Let's go and find them!
